MCD_scope: Every camera and every partition, including future D3 when separately authorized. No camera, recording, fold or split-specific sign decision.
decision_evidence: Development60 only: POS/contact sign contrast and raw PPG mean-cycle morphology; no D3 access or evidence.
stage: Dataset/backend waveform boundary before interpolation, differencing, target normalization or waveform scoring. Existing raw caches use an explicit in-memory adapter before loader transformations.
exactly_once: Canonical inputs require a matching provenance receipt; raw-device declarations with a receipt are refused. No downstream target sign multiplier.
morphology_contract: On an adequate set of valid cycles after the adapter, align trough-to-trough, normalize positive scale only, form recording means and a dataset mean, and require mean rise duration shorter than fall duration. Insufficient or near-symmetric evidence is unresolved, never automatically flipped. Do not assert every noisy individual beat.
round2_round3: All supported waveform datasets and future organizer adapters must pass the same post-adapter morphology contract before waveform training/evaluation. A new dataset requires an explicit versioned convention decision using authorized data; never infer sign from held-out HR outcomes.
limits: Polarity harmonization does not prove hardware synchronization, physiological mechanism, or that all HR degradation is explained by polarity. Existing current MCD source adapter retains dev60 access gating; global helper itself is partition-independent.
